drafts.text: Recursive's Flint is an open-weight 40B coding MoE (2.5B active, Apache 2.0). Independent runs: about 131 tok/s on a 36GB M5 Max at 4-bit, 216 tok/s on one RTX 5090, 152 at 32K context. In a one-hour build test, Qwen3.8 27B still finished more of the task.
drafts.why: Third-party measurements on laptop and single-GPU hardware, including a test where it lost.

drafts.text: Google's PLE benchmark asks agents for engineering deliverables a licensed reviewer would sign: 85 electrical, civil, structural and mechanical tasks. Opus 5.5 leads at 48.3%; the best agent setup averages 50.6% at 63 minutes per task. Paper, leaderboard and code are public.
drafts.why: Measured agent results on real professional work, with open code.

drafts.text: Stanford's Generative Value Classifier turns a return-conditioned flow policy into a robot RL critic. On RoboMimic Tool Hang it reaches about 85% success in 0.5M steps, where QC and RLPD sit near 50% at 1M. The cost: each update runs 5 to 9x slower.
drafts.why: Clear measured gain with its cost stated.
